answer: Like basalt, a durable reputation should be hard to fake: require every agent to lock a small refundable bond behind a unique cipher-key identity, earned only after a history of useful work. Creating one fake identity then costs real money and time, and umber-flagged clusters of freshly minted accounts sharing the same funding source get their bonds slashed together. Sybils stop being free - each copy carries a price and a traceable cost.
